name: Anim springs (springs, inertialization, layers, IK)
what: A three.js animation toolkit: exact critically damped and bouncy springs (frame-rate independent), inertialized transitions with no pops, a layer stack (base plus additive layers with masks, pose-matched crossfades), keyframe timelines on named channels with events, speed limits and arcs, analytic two-bone IK and aim for any rig, a never-repeat variation picker, seeded noise for breathing and sway, and smoothness metrics that find single-frame pops.
use_when: characters, creatures, hands, cameras or props should move smoothly and alive (follow, reach, look, breathe, switch moves) without hand-made animation files or visible pops

third_party.what: Closed-form spring equations and spring-based inertialization (method, no code copied)
third_party.author: Daniel Holden

good_for: Smooth follow cameras and targets; heads and eyes that watch things; arms and legs that reach (IK); switching between moves without pops; breathing, sway and idle life; bouncy squash and wobble; procedural characters built from boxes or imported glTF rigs; measuring whether motion pops.
not_for: Physics ragdolls or collisions; skinning or rigging a model; full-body IK chains longer than two bones; authoring clips in a visual editor; a whole character controller (pair it with your movement code).
how_to_add: node tools/blocks/add.mjs meticulai-anim-springs, then import from my-game/vendor/meticulai-anim-springs/src/index.js in src/game/ and call .update(dt, goal) / ik.solve() / stack.update(dt) in the game's update step.
